name: masra-youth-house-static
description: Maison de Jeunes de Masra website with a secure Meta Graph API backend for live Facebook Page posts.

scripts.build: node --check server.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('index.html'))throw new Error('Missing index.html');if(!fs.existsSync('server.mjs'))throw new Error('Missing server.mjs');console.log('Website and Facebook feed server are ready.');"
scripts.lint: node --check server.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');const h=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8');const a=h.indexOf('<script type=\"module\">');const b=h.lastIndexOf('</script>');if(a<0||b<=a)throw new Error('Missing module script');const js=h.slice(a+'<script type=\"module\">'.length,b);fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/mjm_lint.mjs',js);cp.execFileSync('node',['--check','/tmp/mjm_lint.mjs']);fs.unlinkSync('/tmp/mjm_lint.mjs');console.log('Server and browser JavaScript syntax OK');"
